verdict.rationale: Antigravity's own docs say the Editor view offers 'tab autocompletion', which covers inline completions as you type, but only as a single marketing-level mention. Next-edit suggestions, the second half of the story, are not evidenced anywhere. Missing for 10: any evidence of next-edit suggestions, in-depth docs on completion behavior (multi-line, context, latency), independent or hands-on corroboration of autocomplete quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type

citations.quote: Google Antigravity's Editor view offers tab autocompletion, natural language code commands, and a configurable, and context-aware configurable agent.
offers tab autocompletion, natural language code commands
